content.text: OverviewCampus Life Large • UrbanAverage Per Year After Aid$30KSt. John's University is a large, 4-year, private university. This coed college is located in a large city in an urban setting. It offers certificate, associate, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees. This college has an acceptance rate of 83.42% and a graduation rate of 68%.From the InstitutionSt. John's University is a private, coeducational, Roman Catholic University founded in 1870 by the Congregation of the Mission (the Vincentians), with its main campus in Queens, NY.
